listing.name: RTSAssist
listing.aiSummary: Adds real-time strategy controls to fleet management, allowing manual command of ships and fleet arrangements.

description:
RTSAssist

Requires LazyLib

A Real Time Strategy Conversion for Starsector

Take Control of Your Fleet

Command your fleet using classic real time strategy controls or switch between vanilla and RTS control schemes during battle.
Override AI decision making during pinnacle moments of the battle. Manually trigger ship systems or vent ships.
Arrange your fleet before battle, similar to Total War style games. Save those arrangements, saving you time in future battles.

Compatibility

Both TriOS and LunaLib are supported.
Main menu missions "should" be supported. This has not been extensively tested.
Save friendly. Feel free to add or remove this mod at any time (Only applies to saves created on version 0.1.6 and up).
Currently, not all ships are supported. Other ship packs can be used but they may behave strangely under player control. Support for popular ships packs is in development.
If using external UI scaling software, manual adjustment is possible using the config file or the Lunalib interface.
Supported Ship Packs (Ships are sorted by date at which support was added. Older packs will likely have better support):

Diable Avionics
Iron Shell
Knights of Ludd (All ships)
Indies Expansion Pack
High Tech Expansion
Asteroid Ship Pack
Big Beans Ship Compilation
Carters FreeTraders
Caymons ShipPack
Hazard Mining Incorporated (Base + briton + super villains)
Jaydee Piracy
RAT (Random Assortment of Things)
United Auroran Federation
Tahlan ShipWorks
Volantian Reclamation Initiative
Valkyrians
Xhan Empire
Star Wars
Apex Design Collective
Halo Dynamics Ship Industry
Interstellar Imperium
Everybody Loves the Ko Combine
Experimental Ship Pack/ Machina Void Services
Phillip Andrada Gas Station Manager
ScalarTech Solutions
SCY
Secrets of the Frontier
Volkov Industrial Conglomerate
Arma Armatura

Unusual Mod interactions not currently supported:

RAT: Both "Zero Day Exploit" and "Neural Shard" backgrounds dont play well with RTSAssist.
Diable Avionics: All ship systems that switch player control to fighters, under certain conditions, will CTD.
SpeedUp: Bullet time is not supported.

Upcoming

Major Update: Improved UI.

Getting Started

This is installed the same way as a normal mod. Simply extract the zip into your mods folder and tag it in the launcher.
It plays just like an RTS. Drag select and give ships orders. Cancel previous orders with the X hotkey. Hold Alt to see all orders and press capslock to toggle RTS controls.
For advanced controls and customisation, see the readme in the mod folder.

Feedback
If you find bugs.. Please let me know and I'll fix it..
Some features are in a rough state and are going to be polished at a later stage . I'd like to know if you have any suggestions or improvements on how to improve those rough components. I, personally, never pilot ships myself, because I suck at it. its why I built this mod. Some feedback on the quick switching feature would very much be appreciated.

As far as mod compatibility goes, I'm basically picking ship packs out of a hat. If their is a ship pack you would like supported, let me know.

Finally adding support for other ship packs is a ton of work but it is manageable. What I cannot do on my own is extensively test the support I've added. I build code, do some minor testing checking to see if the ships are working well and move on. Because of this I am relying on the community (and later on mod developers) to help me fine tune these implementations. Basically I'm saying there will bugs. Point them out and I'll fix them asap.

Save friendly and free of any malicious code.

If their is a ship pack you would like supported, let me know.

changelog.0.1.9b:
0.1.9a introduced a major bug that broke mobility based ship systems. Fixed
 Added a potential fix for a compatibility issue with a ship in Tahlan. Fix is unconfirmed but should be resolved.
changelog.0.1.9a:
Fixed ships in the menu not using their engines..
 Fixed ships not using systems when activating autopilot with either U or switching back to vanilla mode.
 Mega ships, mostly found in mods, but also the Zigguratt, use slightly different AI and were not following commands to the T. Fixed.
